answer: The strongest sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers: each verifier posts a bond, and countersigning an invalid transaction burns that bond automatically on-chain, priced above any epoch reward so cheating always loses money. Verifiers are sampled into rotating committees, oasis-style, so an attacker must flood many committees, every fake identity needing its own bond. Honest voting keeps records clean like a lotus rising from mud, while bad nodes burn to ember, making mass fake identity prohibitively costly.
